description: Cellular and compartmentalised. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa in lower right area facing left toward TV wall, additional armchair near coffee table; dining table with 6 seats positioned in centre-right. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 2 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously. Storage: one wardrobe. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households. Not suitable for: large families needing multiple bathrooms (only one bathroom for a 3-bedroom unit); households requiring step-free direct entry into living (L-shaped corridor entry); those wanting a private ensuite master suite.
